description: Correlation graph mapping ERP features to functions, screens, workflows, database tables, voucher types, reports, manuals, safety boundaries, aliases, and expected answer types. Designed to make Ask ERP Brain behave as a relationship tracer rather than a loose search engine.

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Provides a centralized overview of key ERP metrics including pending orders, outstanding receivables, stock status, and recent transactions.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not allow record creation, posting, or data modification. It is a read-only summary view.
commonQuestions: What metrics does the dashboard show?
knownGaps: Dashboard does not show real-time financial position

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Allows creation and management of master records including companies, departments, suppliers, items, banks, warehouses, employees, and expense heads.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not handle transactions, vouchers, posting, or financial reporting.
commonQuestions: How do I add a supplier?
How do I create an item?
sourceReferences: DG-1 tables: companies, suppliers, items, banks, warehouses, employees

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Manages the current company context. All transactions, reports, and data are scoped to the selected company.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not create or modify company master data from this context selector.

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Manages government department master records including department name, code, contact details, and billing information.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not handle transactions, purchase orders, or billing. It is a master data screen only.
commonQuestions: How do I add a government department?

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Manages supplier master records including supplier name, GSTIN, address, contact, bank details, and credit terms.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not handle purchase orders, payments, or procurement transactions.
commonQuestions: How do I add a supplier?

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Manages item master records including item name, HSN/SAC code, unit of measure, rate, GST rate, and stock category.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not handle stock transactions, purchases, or sales. It is a master data screen only.
commonQuestions: How do I add an item?
How do I set GST rate for an item?

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Manages bank account master records including bank name, account number, IFSC code, branch, and opening balance.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not handle bank reconciliation, payments, or receipts.
commonQuestions: How do I add a bank account?

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Manages warehouse/godown master records including location, address, and storage capacity.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not handle stock movement, GRN, or delivery challan.
commonQuestions: How do I add a warehouse?

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Manages employee master records including name, designation, department, contact, and user role.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not handle payroll, attendance, or HR transactions.
commonQuestions: How do I add an employee?

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Creates and manages Purchase Orders and GeM orders for procuring goods and services from suppliers.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not post accounting entries, does not create inventory movement, does not handle billing.
commonQuestions: How do I create a GeM order?
What is the difference between PO and Work Order?
knownGaps: GeM API integration not yet implemented — orders are entered manually

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Operational root of the government supply lifecycle. Creates supply orders to fulfill purchase orders, tracks order progress through the lifecycle.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not create accounting entries directly. Does not handle billing, receipts, or inventory directly. It is the operational parent entity.
commonQuestions: Is Work Order the same as Purchase Order?
sourceReferences: KG-4: WORK_ORDER has no direct accounting impact
Rule 29: Work Order / Supply Order Parent Entity Rule

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Planned procurement of materials and services based on work order requirements. Generates procurement schedules.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not directly create purchase orders or supplier POs. It is a planning stage.
commonQuestions: How do I create a procurement plan?
knownGaps: Procurement plan does not auto-generate supplier POs

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Creates purchase orders issued to suppliers for procurement of goods. Generates purchase voucher upon receipt.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not post ledger entries until goods are received and purchase voucher is created.
commonQuestions: How do I create a supplier PO?

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Records receipt of goods from suppliers. Updates stock ledger and triggers inventory valuation.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not post accounting vouchers. Purchase voucher posting is a separate step.
commonQuestions: How do I create a GRN?

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Reserves inventory for specific work orders or delivery challans. Ensures stock availability for committed deliveries.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not move physical stock or post accounting entries. Reservation is a planning hold.

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Creates delivery challans for dispatching goods to customers/government departments. Tracks outward stock movement.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not create invoices or accounting entries. Billing is a separate downstream step.
commonQuestions: How do I create a DC?
Is DC the same as invoice?

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Tracks site installation and commissioning of delivered equipment/goods.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not handle billing or accounting. Installation is an operational milestone.
knownGaps: Installation workflow is partial — no mandatory completion checklist

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Records Consignee Receipt and Acceptance Certificate — formal acceptance of delivered goods by the consignee. Acts as billing readiness evidence.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not create invoices or post accounting entries. CRAC is an operational milestone that enables downstream invoicing.

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Creates sales invoices/GST invoices for goods and services supplied. Posts accounting entries, updates stock ledger, records GST liability, creates department receivable.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not handle receipts, payments, or purchase billing. It is for sales invoicing only.
commonQuestions: How do I create a GST invoice?

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Displays a list of all created invoices/bills for review. Provides navigation to individual invoice details.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not create new invoices. Does not show live payment status or balances. It is a read-only listing of created bills.
commonQuestions: How do I view past invoices?

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Tracks amounts receivable from government departments. Shows outstanding invoices, aging, and payment status.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not post receipts or write off receivables. It is a read-only tracking view.

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Records receipt of payments from government departments. Posts accounting entries, updates receivables, records cash/bank impact.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not handle payments to suppliers. Does not create sales invoices.
commonQuestions: How do I record a receipt?

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Records payments made to suppliers. Posts accounting entries, updates supplier balances, records cash/bank impact.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not handle receipts from customers. Does not create purchase orders.
commonQuestions: How do I make a supplier payment?

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Records business expenses. Posts accounting entries to appropriate expense heads.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not handle supplier payments or purchase bills.
commonQuestions: How do I record an expense?

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Guided accounting entry creation for common business transactions. Provides a simplified interface to create accounting vouchers.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Is not the same as Work Order/Supply Order. Does not handle operational lifecycle.
commonQuestions: How do I create a business voucher?
Is business voucher same as work order?

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Creates manual accounting entries including journal vouchers, contra entries, and opening balances. Posts directly to ledger.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not handle operational transactions. It is for manual accounting corrections and adjustments.
commonQuestions: How do I create a journal entry?

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Central hub showing all voucher types and providing navigation to create or review accounting entries. Guided voucher creation workflow.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Is not the same as Work Order/Supply Order. Does not handle operational lifecycle. Does not post entries itself.
commonQuestions: Is voucher dashboard same as work order?
Can I post from voucher dashboard?

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Records opening balances for ledger accounts at the start of a financial year. Posts to ledger as opening entries.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not handle transactions for the current period. Opening balance is a one-time entry per financial year.
commonQuestions: How do I set opening balance?
knownGaps: KG4-GAP-004: Opening balances have no reversal support

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Shows the trial balance — a summary of all ledger account balances. Used to verify that total debits equal total credits.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not show live balances. Does not post entries. The assistant cannot show actual balance figures.
sourceReferences: DG-1 report: Trial Balance sourced from ledger_entries
KG-4 report: Trial Balance mapped to ledger_entries

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Shows the profit and loss statement — revenue, expenses, and net profit/loss for a period.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not show live balances. Does not post entries. The assistant cannot show actual profit figures.
sourceReferences: DG-1 report: P&L sourced from ledger_entries
KG-4 report: P&L mapped to ledger_entries

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Shows the balance sheet — assets, liabilities, and equity at a given date.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not show live balances. Does not post entries. The assistant cannot show actual balance figures.
sourceReferences: DG-1 report: Balance Sheet sourced from ledger_entries
KG-4 report: Balance Sheet mapped to ledger_entries

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Shows the detailed ledger for any account — all debit and credit entries with running balance.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not show live balances. The assistant cannot show actual ledger entries.
commonQuestions: How do I view a ledger report?

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Shows all cash and bank transactions — receipts, payments, and contra entries affecting cash/bank accounts.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not show live balances. The assistant cannot show actual cash/bank figures.
knownGaps: KG4-GAP-001: Cash/Bank Book report has no dedicated function

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Generates GST reports including GST register, input/output tax summary, and GSTR-1/GSTR-3B data.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not file GST returns. Does not calculate GST — it displays GST data from posted transactions.

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Generates TDS reports showing tax deducted at source on payments and receipts.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not file TDS returns. Does not calculate TDS — it displays TDS data from posted transactions.

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Shows the stock ledger — all inward and outward stock movements with running quantity and valuation.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not show live stock balances. Does not handle stock movement.

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Shows the current valuation of inventory stock based on average cost or FIFO method.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not show live stock value. The assistant cannot show actual valuation figures.

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Analyzes profitability per work order. Compares revenue from invoices against costs including materials, expenses, and overheads.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not show live profit figures. Does not post entries. Analysis is based on posted transaction data.

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Matches ERP bank transactions against bank statements to identify differences and reconcile balances.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not post entries. Does not modify bank transactions.

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Imports master data and transactions from Tally ERP via XML export files. Creates master records and vouchers.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not post ledger entries directly. Imported vouchers may require review before posting.
commonQuestions: How do I import from Tally?

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Migrates master data (companies, departments, suppliers, items) from Tally ERP.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not import transactions or vouchers. Master migration should precede transaction import.
commonQuestions: How do I migrate masters from Tally?

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Imports data from spreadsheet/CSV files for bulk creation of master records and transactions.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not post accounting entries. Does not handle live data import without staging/preview.
commonQuestions: How do I import from Excel?

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Exports ERP data (reports, lists, transactions) to spreadsheet/CSV format for offline analysis.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not modify ERP data. Export is a read-only operation.
commonQuestions: How do I export to Excel?

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Provides fallback API endpoints when running in browser preview mode instead of Electron desktop.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not replace desktop ERP functionality. Browser mode is for preview/testing only.

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Provides contextual help for ERP screens. Answers user questions about navigation, workflow, and accounting using BRAIN-2/BRAIN-3 intelligence.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not post entries, modify data, or access live records. It is a read-only guidance assistant.
commonQuestions: How do I use Help Assistant?
How do I get help for a screen?

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Answers ERP questions using source-backed intelligence from BRAIN-2/BRAIN-4 knowledge graphs and manuals. Provides feature/function correlation via FF-1.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not post entries, access live records, or take actions. It is a read-only question-answering assistant.
commonQuestions: How do I ask a question?
What can I ask the Brain?
knownGaps: Natural language understanding is limited to keyword matching — no LLM integration

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Creates database backups and restores from previous backups. Critical for data safety and disaster recovery.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not handle individual record backup. Backup is full database only.
commonQuestions: How do I take a backup?
How do I restore from backup?

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Manages approval workflows for orders, vouchers, and other records requiring authorization.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not auto-approve records. Approval is a manual user action.
commonQuestions: How do I approve a record?
knownGaps: Approval workflow is manual — no auto-routing

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Locks a financial year after closure. Prevents posting to locked periods. Manages financial year periods.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not automatically close accounts. Locking is an administrative action after year-end procedures.
commonQuestions: How do I lock a financial year?
sourceReferences: KG-4 accounting protection: financial year lock

featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoes: Records all user actions, data changes, and system events for audit and compliance purposes.
featureNodes.whatThisFeatureDoesNotDo: Does not show live data. Does not allow modification of audit records.
commonQuestions: How do I view audit log?
knownGaps: AG-1 audit event catalog is descriptive; live audit_log rows are not yet mapped to AG-1 event IDs at runtime
sourceReferences: AG-1 audit intelligence graph (active — event catalog)

functionNodes.description: Creates a sales invoice / GST invoice. Posts accounting entries, updates stock ledger, records GST liability, creates department receivable.
Posts a debit/credit entry to the general ledger. Used by all accounting voucher creation functions.
Creates a receipt voucher recording payment received from a government department. Posts to ledger and updates receivables.
Creates a payment voucher recording payment made to a supplier. Posts to ledger and updates supplier balances.
Creates a manual journal voucher entry. Posts debit/credit pairs to the general ledger.
Creates a contra voucher for transfers between cash and bank accounts.
Creates a guided business voucher using simplified templates for common business transactions.
Creates a purchase voucher upon receipt of goods from a supplier. Posts purchase accounting entries.
Records receipt of goods from supplier. Updates stock ledger with inward movement and triggers inventory valuation.
Creates a delivery challan for outward dispatch of goods. Updates stock ledger with outward movement.
Records opening balance entries for ledger accounts at the start of a financial year.
Resolves a user query by searching knowledge graphs, manuals, and source references to find the best matching feature/function answer.
Classifies a user query into an expected answer type (navigation, workflow, accounting_ref, report_ref, procedure, definition) for routing to the correct knowledge source.
Creates a full database backup. Can also restore from a previous backup file.
Generates financial reports (Trial Balance, Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, Ledger, Cash/Bank Book) from ledger data.
